The '''Dance Barn''' is a building in [[Badgetown]] that hosts [[dance tournament|dance tournaments]] for citizens of [[Badgetown]].

== Unlocking ==
The Dance Barn is locked until the Player completes the [[Tinstle Tasks|Tinstle Task]] "Reopen the Dance Barn." Originally, the Dance Barn is owned by [[Bazil]],<ref>''"I bought [the dance barn] after it became decrepit as a speculative investment that's never paid off."'' – [[Bazil]]</ref> who will ask the Player to bring him 20 [[Planklet|planklets]], 12 [[Nurny|nurnies]], 4 [[clothlets]], 1 [[oobsidian]], and 300 [[gummies]] for him to repair the building, which he will "donate" back to the town upon completion.<ref>''"Tell you what: If you bring the supplies needed to repair it and pay me for the cost of labor, and the cost of the lot… I'll hire someone to fix it up and donate the whole barn back to the town."'' – [[Bazil]]</ref>

== Dance Tournaments ==
Dance Tournaments take place once per day, and the player can join or leave whenever they want. They consist of 3 [[Dance Battle|Dance Battles]] against other [[Characters]] starting with a 1v1 battle, then 2v2 and finally 3v3. The prizes and rulesets for the next 4 days can be seen when joining the tournament.

=== Rulesets ===
Dance Tournaments will have one of three possible modifiers applied to them, you can see the ruleset for the current day's tournament as well as the next 4 days' when you join the tournament.
* Normal - The rules of the dance battles are just as in a regular [[Dance Battle|dance battle]]
* Signatures Only - Only signature moves of [[ooblets]] can be used
* Freebie - All moves cost 0 beats
